articles.title: SpaceX Said to Cut IPO Valuation Goal to at Least $1.8 Trillion
articles.summary: SpaceX is currently targeting a valuation of at least $1.8 trillion in its initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, as Elon Musk’s rocket and artificial intelligence company nears its debut.
articles.author: Kiel Porter, Edward Ludlow

articles.title: Why The SpaceX IPO Is Unlike Any Other
articles.summary: What began as a rocket startup is now a big bet on satellites, AI and Mars. With a projected valuation of at least $1.8 trillion, SpaceX’s IPO could reshape markets. But is Wall Street rushing in too fast? (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Anthropic raises $65 billion, nears $1T valuation ahead of IPO
articles.summary: Anthropic has closed a $65 billion Series H round at a $965 billion post-money valuation, marking what could be the AI startup's final private fundraise before a highly anticipated IPO.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: DeepZero Says IPO Success Signals Strong Belief in AI
articles.summary: Beijing DeepZero Chairwoman Grace Huang says the market’s reaction to the its Hong Kong IPO is a sign that people are recognizing the power of AI. DeepZero's shares surged more than 260% on its debut on May 27. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Africa Startups Turn Inward as US AI Boom Drains Venture Capital
articles.summary: African startups are rewriting their funding playbook as the global artificial intelligence boom pulls venture capital toward the US, forcing emerging markets to compete for cash.
articles.author: Rivaldo Jantjies

articles.title: Anthropic reaches valuation of $965bn, beating OpenAI to become world’s most valuable AI firm
articles.summary: Claude’s parent company’s $65bn in latest funding round underscores vast sums of money still flowing into industryAnthropic, the AI firm behind the Claude chatbot, announced on Thursday it had raised $65bn in funding to value the company at $965bn post-money. The move makes Anthropic the world’s most valuable AI startup, eclipsing its competitor OpenAI.The deal marks an exceedingly successful period of growth for Anthropic, which was once considered to be a smaller player in the global AI arms race. The widespread adoption of its products by large enterprise businesses, especially following its release of powerful coding assistants late last year, has turned it into a dominant player in the industry. articles.title: Anthropic Nears $1T Valuation And Leapfrogs OpenAI On Unicorn Board With $65B Funding Round
articles.summary: Generative AI company Anthropic announced on Thursday that it has raised $65 billion in a Series H funding round, more than doubling its post-money valuation to a staggering $965 billion.

articles.title: Memory Chip Giant CXMT Heads for China’s Biggest IPO Since 2022
articles.summary: Memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies Inc. has received approval from the Shanghai Stock Exchange for an initial public offering that’s on track to be the biggest in mainland China since 2022, in a milestone for one of the key technologies of the artificial intelligence buildout.

articles.title: SpaceX Investor Powerlaw to Debut on Nasdaq as IPO Race Heats Up
articles.summary: Powerlaw Corp., a closed-end fund that owns stakes in Elon Musk’s SpaceX and artificial intelligence firm OpenAI, is going public without raising any capital in the latest public vehicle to cater to retail investors’ clamor for exposure to the hottest private tech companies.

articles.title: Plenty of Ways to Play AI Trade in Europe, Goldman Sachs Says
articles.summary: Sharon Bell, equity strategist at Goldman Sachs, discusses the artificial intelligence trade and why she thinks European stocks, and not just tech firms, can benefit. She speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Bridging Africa’s Innovation Gap: From Potential To Power
articles.summary: While Africa’s innovation ecosystem is growing rapidly, it still faces major challenges, writes Mind the Bridge's Alberto Onetti, who argues that the continent's weak electrical grid infrastructure and limited domestic venture capital will need large-scale public and private investment to unlock its economic and technological potential.

articles.title: Fireworks AI in Talks for Funding at $15 Billion Valuation
articles.summary: Fireworks AI, a startup that helps companies run artificial intelligence models, is in talks to raise a new round of funding that would value the company at $15 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: SoftBank Shares Hit Record With Lift From OpenAI IPO Hopes
articles.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. shares climbed to a record high, spurred by hopes of big returns from the Japanese investor’s stakes in OpenAI and SB Energy Corp., should the two go public.
